paid.name: Fantasy Props MegaKit, Pro or Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.formats: glTF, FBX, OBJ; Source adds .blend and engine projects
paid.contents: All 211 props (the free tier has 94): more weapons, shields, tools, stalls, chests, carts and banners, worn texture variants and collisions.
paid.why: The anchor kit itself; Mike liked every piece of it shown so far.

paid.name: Medieval Village MegaKit, Pro or Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.contents: All 304 modular pieces (the free tier has about 170); Source's .blend files are the practical way to make the lighter corner posts and doors the game needs.
paid.why: The anchor kit Mike's approved whole buildings came from.

paid.name: Stylized Nature MegaKit, Pro or Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.formats: glTF, FBX, OBJ; Source adds .blend and a grass wind shader
paid.contents: About 116 models: 40 trees with 7 swappable leaf types, 35 plants and flowers, 27 rocks, grass and bushes.
paid.why: Mike likes its broadleaf trees, shrubs, grass and flowers; its pines stay on the fence.

paid.name: Universal Base Characters, Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.contents: 6 bodies in Regular, Teen and Superhero builds, 20 hairstyles, skin and eye shaders; humanoid rig, about 13,000 triangles.
paid.why: The anchor line's people; the Regular build has the natural proportions the free Superhero tier lacks.

paid.name: Modular Character Outfits – Fantasy, Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.contents: 12 outfits from about 70 parts (peasant, noble, wizard, ranger, knight and more), 3 texture variants each.
paid.why: The anchor line's clothing for its base characters.

paid.name: Universal Animation Library, Pro or Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.formats: FBX, GLB; Source adds the .blend rig
paid.contents: 120+ humanoid clips (the free tier has 45): locomotion, combat, swimming, emotes, root-motion versions.
paid.why: Made for the anchor characters.

paid.name: Universal Animation Library 2, Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.contents: 110–130 clips: farming, fishing, melee combos, climbing, zombie motion, idles and emotes.
paid.why: Made for the anchor characters; covers work and social motion.

paid.name: Bestiary – Dungeon Monsters Kit, Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.license: Quaternius Asset License 1.0: game use allowed, files may not be redistributed
paid.contents: 7 armed monsters (goblin, skeleton, demon, lycan and others), 3 colours each, humanoid rig.
paid.why: The anchor line's monsters; its licence keeps the files out of the public study collection.

paid.name: Quaternius Patreon (all Source kits)
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.price: $20 a month for 30 credits (Source kits about 30% off)
paid.contents: Credits claim Source versions; patrons also get an all-in-one file of every pack.
paid.why: The cheapest way to get every anchor kit's full version at once.

paid.name: Human Basic Motions
paid.creator: Kevin Iglesias
paid.license: commercial use; terms not shown on the page
paid.contents: 404 files: locomotion, swimming, sitting, sleeping, eating, looting, conversations, waving, cheering.
paid.why: Style-neutral motion; retargeting to the Quaternius skeleton is unverified.

paid.name: Human Crafting Animations
paid.creator: Kevin Iglesias
paid.license: commercial use; terms not shown on the page
paid.contents: 322 files: chopping, ploughing, fishing, gathering, hammering, mining, sowing, skinning, watering.
paid.why: Work loops for villagers; rig compatibility unverified.

paid.name: Melee, Archer and Spellcasting animation packs
paid.creator: Kevin Iglesias
paid.license: commercial use; terms not shown on the page
paid.contents: One- and two-handed weapons, polearms, shields, bows and magic, with root-motion and in-place versions.
paid.why: Covers guards, soldiers, hunters and mages; rig compatibility unverified.

paid.name: Ultimate 3D Animal Pack (100+ animals)
paid.creator: WildMesh 3D
paid.license: RenderHub Extended Use: commercial use, no file redistribution
paid.contents: Fox, boar, rabbit, lynx, raccoon, badger, beaver, crow, duck, goose, chicken, pheasant, trout, horse, donkey, cow, goat, cat, dogs, wolves, bears, deer and more; idle, walk, run, attack and death each.
paid.why: The anatomy of Mike's first-choice animals, but with realistic rather than painted coats; would need a painted pass.

paid.name: Single realistic animals
paid.creator: WildMesh 3D
paid.contents: Moose, deer, elk, bighorn, doe, pronghorn, bear and others, rigged with many clips.
paid.why: Same anatomy as the painted favourites; realistic coats.
